name: example query set
description: An ILLUSTRATIVE set showing the format and the four intent categories. It is not a measurement of anything and must never be reported as one: its provenance is 'example', so QuerySet.is_evidence is false and any report built from it leads with a line saying the numbers are illustrative. Replace it with a set exported from the queries a running system was actually asked.
